title: Charles D NDE 4411
content: I had been taking medication for my heart and blood pressure. I was outside with Sara. We were planting some tomatoes at the back door of our trailer. We finished with one pot of tomatoes, so I brought it around to the front yard and grabbed another pot to plant the others in. When I put the pot down, I got a little dizzy and tried to tell her but I could barely speak. I went in and sat down in my chair where I eat at the dining room table. I remember trying to call Sara a couple of times but I think the dogs brought it to her attention. She came in and I was leaning to one side and kept on leaning. Then there was no light and I was floating above my body. It looked like it was an orange or bold color. I thought for a minute, 'Oh I am on the other side.' Then I heard the words 'leave me.' From that moment, I saw my body again. I said to myself, 'Wow, I'm floating and I don't hear that stupid ringing in my ears.' Then I zoomed back into my body. 'Whoa, was I dead?' Sara said that my heart stopped, I stopped breathing, and let out a gasp of air. That must have been when I saw myself and realized I was floating. It happened so fast though and it was not like I had thought because there was no Light at all except my glowing body.

environment.environment_other_detail: No light; experiencer reports floating above body and perceived own body as 'an orange or bold color' / 'glowing body'.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Heart/blood pressure condition; episode described as heart stopping and stopped breathing per witness (Sara).

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Darkness/no light; perceived own body as orange/bold/glowing; heard words 'leave me'; sudden return ('zoomed back into my body').
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE occurred with darkness/no tunnel/light; brief auditory message ('leave me'); rapid involuntary return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: No Light reported ('no Light at all except my glowing body'); heard words 'leave me'; noticed absence of chronic ringing in ears during OBE.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Then there was no light and I was floating above my body.” “Oh I am on the other side.” “leave me.” “Wow, I'm floating and I don't hear that stupid ringing in my ears.” “It happened so fast though and it was not like I had thought because there was no Light at all except my glowing body.”
